select w.id, w.weighing_no, w.plate_no, w.weighing_type, w.goods_name, w.goods_spec, w.weighing_weight, w.weight_unit, w.weighing_station, w.weighing_time, w.receipt_type, case when d.id is not null then d.receipt_code when s.id is not null then s.receipt_code end as doc_code, case when d.id is not null then d.receipt_status when s.id is not null then s.receipt_status end as doc_status, case when d.id is not null then 'delivery' when s.id is not null then 'sendcar' end as doc_type from ( select id, weighing_no, plate_no, weighing_type, goods_name, goods_spec, weighing_weight, weight_unit, weighing_station, weighing_time, receipt_type, receipt_head_id from dic_weigh_weight where is_delete = 0 and
plate_no = #{vehicleNo} plate_no like concat('%', #{vehicleNo}, '%')
order by weighing_time desc, id desc limit #{size} ) w left join biz_receipt_delivery_notice_head d on w.receipt_type = 220 and w.receipt_head_id = d.id left join biz_receipt_send_car_head s on w.receipt_type = 811 and w.receipt_head_id = s.id order by w.weighing_time desc, w.id desc
